caption_L1: This is a area chart labeled Number of employees at agricultural manufacturer Claas from 2000 to 2019. Along the y-axis, Number of employees is defined on a linear scale of range 0 to 12,000. A linear scale from 2000 to 2015 can be seen along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: There is a trend for the number of employees at agricultural manufacturer Claas to gradually increase over time, from just under 6,000 in the year 2000 to just under 12,000 in the year 2019. There are no large decreases in the number of employees at anytime, however there are two notable large, steep increases where the number of employees quickly rose by around 2,000. These occur around 2002-2003 and 2012-2014.
